title: Design System: Barneysbro City Route Atlas

display.purpose: Large direct statements and product titles.

label.purpose: Short regions, locations, and route codes.

shadows.name: product-plate
shadows.purpose: Physical depth for real App screenshots only.

shadows.name: app-icon
shadows.purpose: Small lift for native App icons.

motion.name: route-arrival
motion.purpose: One-time product-copy arrival as a route stop enters view.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Immediate action inversion and two-pixel lift.

components.name: Dark Route Action
components.description: Primary action on Signal Yellow and other light fields.
components.css: .ds-action-dark { display:inline-flex; min-height:50px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:12px 18px; border:2px solid #101722; border-radius:0; background:#101722; color:#fff; font:700 14px 'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background 150ms ease,transform 150ms ease; } .ds-action-dark:hover { background:#1436b8; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-action-dark:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #0b57ff; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Outlined Route Action
components.description: App Store action inside a destination field.
components.html: VIEW ON THE APP STORE ↗
components.css: .ds-action-outline { display:inline-flex; min-height:50px; align-items:center; padding:12px 18px; border:2px solid #101722; border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:#101722; font:700 14px 'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background 150ms ease,color 150ms ease,transform 150ms ease; } .ds-action-outline:hover { background:#101722; color:#fff; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-action-outline:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #0b57ff; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Studio Navigation
components.description: Fixed cool-paper bar that becomes Signal Yellow over the hero.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; min-height:74px; align-items:center; gap:28px; padding:0 34px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(16,23,34,.18); background:#ffd21c; color:#101722; font:700 13px 'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { margin-right:auto; font:760 16px 'Anybody','Noto Sans TC',sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color:inherit; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav button { min-width:48px; min-height:44px; border:1px solid #101722; border-radius:0; background:transparent; font:inherit; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible,.ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #0b57ff; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Route Station
components.description: Current-location marker for the desktop portfolio route.
components.css: .ds-station { display:grid; width:36px; height:36px; place-items:center; border:2px solid #101722; border-radius:50%; background:#ffd21c; color:#101722; font:800 10px 'Anybody',sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 180ms ease; } .ds-station:hover { transform:scale(1.12); } .ds-station:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #0b57ff; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Product Proof Plate
components.description: A real portrait App screenshot with a hard keyline and ambient depth.
components.css: .ds-proof { width:220px; margin:0; color:#101722; text-align:center; } .ds-proof div { aspect-ratio:800/1739; border:1px solid #101722; background:#f3f6f4; box-shadow:0 28px 54px rgba(16,23,34,.22); } .ds-proof figcaption { margin-top:12px; font:700 11px 'Anybody',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.04em; }

narrative.overview: Barneysbro behaves like a piece of civic wayfinding rather than a generic software landing page. Saturated route fields divide the portfolio into real destinations, hard rules establish direction, and product screenshots are treated as the evidence at each stop.
keyCharacteristics: Full-width municipal color fields, not cards on a neutral canvas.
Real App screenshots at product scale.
Square actions, hard rules, circular route stations.
Flat by default; depth belongs to physical product plates only.

rules.name: The Whole Field Rule
rules.body: Route colors own entire sections. Do not reduce them to tiny accent chips on white cards.

rules.name: The Contrast Pair Rule
rules.body: Transit Ink sits on yellow, mint, orange, and red; white sits on deep blue and ink.

rules.name: The Sign Before Caption Rule
rules.body: Headings carry the message directly. Do not add decorative eyebrow copy above them.

rules.name: The Proof Casts the Shadow Rule
rules.body: Navigation, text containers, and content fields stay flat. Only product evidence receives elevation.

dos: Do give each App an entire route-color field and real screenshot proof.
Do preserve the one-pixel civic rule language and square controls.
Do translate persistent desktop structures into local horizontal rails on mobile.
Do keep content visible when JavaScript or motion is unavailable.
donts: Don't wrap the portfolio in same-size white feature cards.
Don't use gradients, glass panels, emoji controls, or generic icon tiles as substitutes for product evidence.
Don't add unverified ratings, download totals, versions, or feature claims.
Don't animate every section identically; motion should explain progress through the route.
